RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may possess up to one ounce of cannabis flower on their person, or the equivalent in concentrate, and up to 10 ounces at home.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/cannabis-safety/information/cannabis-information-adults.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Rhode Island?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: Under the Rhode Island Cannabis Act, adults 21 and older are allowed to possess up to one ounce of cannabis flower on their person (or an equivalent amount of cannabis concentrate) and up to 10 ounces at home.

RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_quote: Cannabis not grown at home may be purchased legally from a Rhode Island-licensed dispensary.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/cannabis-safety/information/cannabis-information-adults.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for adults to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Rhode Island?
RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_section: Cannabis not grown at home may be purchased legally from a Rhode Island-licensed dispensary, which offer products that are required to undergo testing for THC concentration, or strength, and contaminants.

RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may grow up to three mature and three immature plants.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/cannabis-safety/information/cannabis-information-adults.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for adults to grow cannabis in the state of Rhode Island?
RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_section: They are also allowed to grow up to three mature and three immature plants.

RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_quote: The Cannabis Act does not authorize smoking or vaporizing cannabis in any public place.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://webserver.rilegislature.gov/Statutes/TITLE21/21-28.11/21-28.11-22.HTM.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.question: Is it legal to consume cannabis in parks, on sidewalks, or similar outdoor public spaces in the state of Rhode Island?
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_section: Nothing contained within this chapter or chapter 28.6 of this title shall be construed as authorizing the smoking or vaporizing of cannabis in any public place. The smoking or vaporizing of cannabis is prohibited in any public place that prohibits the smoking or vaporizing of tobacco products as well as any place that prohibits the smoking or vaporizing of cannabis including by rule, regulation, or by local ordinance.

RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_quote: Rhode Island does not license cannabis lounges or other social consumption businesses.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://ccc.ri.gov/faq.
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.question: Is it legal for public businesses such as cafes, bars, or conference centers to allow on-site cannabis consumption in the state of Rhode Island?
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_section: At this time, there are no licenses that would allow for the operation of social consumption businesses in Rhode Island.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: Registered patients may possess a limited amount of marijuana under the Medical Marijuana Act.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/medical-marijuana/information/patients-caregivers.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Rhode Island?
MEDICAL.gov_section: The state's Medical Marijuana Act permits Rhode Island residents with debilitating medical conditions to use marijuana if a physician certifies, in writing, that the marijuana may alleviate their symptoms and that the potential benefits of using medical marijuana would likely outweigh the health risks to the patient.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Once you have a Medical Marijuana you may visit any of the six Rhode Island Compassion Centers to purchase medical marijuana.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/medical-marijuana/information/patients-caregivers.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Rhode Island?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: Once you have a Medical Marijuana you may visit any of the six Rhode Island Compassion Centers to purchase medical marijuana.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: Qualified patients may purchase, possess, and cultivate cannabis for debilitating medical conditions.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.ri.gov/cannabis-safety.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Rhode Island?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: It allows qualified patients to purchase, possess and cultivate cannabis to alleviate symptoms caused by debilitating medical conditions.

The patients-and-caregivers page at /medical-marijuana/information/patients-caregivers still has the stored Medical Marijuana Act possession sentence and the compassion-center purchase sentence; the old /healthcare/medicalmarijuana/for/patients/ URL redirects there.
